beats: Tube came for you. Bureau stamp. That's three this month.
Not where the tables can see. Give it here.
Three payments. I'll catch up. I always catch up.
On tips? Ask your friend. He's looking again.
Who's looking? Nobody's looking. Keep your voice down.
He crosses the whole square for one coffee, Inez.
If the Office hears about Okafor, we're both finished.
Bureau debt. The door guard's her man. Two ways in.
Your Bureau card, miss. Half of it's stamped paid.
Where did you get that? Who's been through my things?
Nobody. I went to the window and paid it.
People don't do that. Not for nothing.
No. One day we might ask you something small.
Then take it back. No. They'd only send another notice.
Keep it. I'll bring the rest.
People can see this door. I've said yes to nothing.
learned: She took it. Not ready yet.

beats: The rest of it. Look. You owe them nothing.
Six years I've paid them. What do you want?
When I telephone, you call Okafor over from his door.
You know about him? Who told you? Who else knows?
Nobody who'd say. He stands with you one minute.
And then what happens to him?
If this goes right, nothing. He never even sees us.
All right. Any trouble on the square, I'll warn you.
opens: Call Inez: he leaves the door

beats: Keep smiling. You and Okafor. The Office doesn't know, yet.
Please. That's his post. This is all I've got.
I know. I don't enjoy this. It changes nothing.
What do you want? Just say what you want.
When I telephone, you call him over. For one minute.
And then you never say his name again?
Never. We keep our word, whatever you think of us.
I've had a good look at your face.
learned: Inez is turned, and resents it.
opens: Call Inez: he leaves the door

beats: Official bay. Cabs are round the front.
You drive the Councillor. Lean month, I hear. This helps.
Heavy. Spell it out. I've been paid vague before.
He gets in at the chime. Don't take him home.
Service bay, round the back, east yard. Park and wait.
Couple of minutes. Then I drive on, whoever's late.
We'll see to the Councillor. You needn't look.
Who's we? Knowing costs extra. I'll shift anyone watching my bay.
learned: Zhou takes Vale's car round back.

beats: It's me. Call him over now, please.
Now. All right. Let me sound like myself first.
Okafor, it's me. Can you come over? Just a minute.
On shift? You've never once asked me that. What's wrong?
Nothing's wrong. I want you here, love. That's all.
He's left the door. He's crossing. Don't you hurt him.
He'll walk back and never know. Thank you, Inez.
